house.sweet_bun: There's a sweet bun here. Looks like the monsters didn't eat it. Let's take it.
house.wooden_door: There's a wooden door. But the handle has fallen off, so you can't open it.
house.companions.child_reunion: Friend 2: Ah! {player}! Long time no see!
Friend 3: Oh, came home for a break, huh?
Kid: {player} rescued me. Then a bunch of stuff happened on the way back, and somehow we landed in a pool. Ha ha!
Friend 3: Don't you 'ha ha' me. Well, whatever. You're heading out again, right? Good luck.
Friend 2: {player}, if you ever feel like coming back, you can come home anytime.
Friend 1: And hurry up and take that kid home, okay?
Kid: I'm not in any hurry. But story-wise, if you don't send me home, the next part of the story can't
house.companions.child_reunion_end: And so, {player} left feeling recharged by the friends' cheering.
house.companions.cheer1: Friends: Go, go, {player}! Fight, fight, {player}! Don't give up, don't give up, {player}! Gooooo!
house.companions.cheer2: Friends: Fight, fight, {player}! Don't lose, don't lose, {player}! See you laaater!
house.companions.gathered: Your friends have gathered in front of the door to see {player} off.
house.companions.gift1: Friend 1: {player}, be careful out there. Here, have some rice balls I bought at the convenience store. I wish I could've made them myself, but the monsters ate all our rice. Oh, and take some sports drinks too. If you drink one when you're tired, it might perk you up.
house.companions.gift2: Friend 2: Be careful, okay? Here are some matsutake mushrooms. They heal a lot of damage, so eat one if you get in a pinch out there. Come home soon.
house.companions.gift3: Friend 3: {player}, don't you dare die. If you die, I'll beat you to a pulp. Here, take this Light Shard. It's super rare, so don't go saying 'let's just try it out.' Use it when you're in a pinch. And if you drop it, you'll be sorry. Okay, take care. Hurry back.
house.slingshot_ball: There's a slingshot pellet on the floor. Let's grab it.
house.shelf: This is actually a door, but there's a huge shelf in front of it. It's completely empty. A totally pointless shelf. It's so big you can't move it. And smashing it doesn't look possible either.
house.window: There's a window. Through it, you can see the next path.
house.slingshot_balls: Slingshot pellets! Might as well take them. You got 100 slingshot pellets.
house.slingshot_balls_no_slingshot: That's great and all, but where's the slingshot?
house.hammer: Somebody left a hammer lying around in here. It's small but pretty heavy, so it might come in handy. Might as well take it.
house.slingshot: There's a wooden slingshot. But with no ammo, it's not much of a weapon yet. Still, let's take it anyway. There might be some pellets somewhere in this room, though.
house.ornament: There's an ornament. A big lucky cat figurine has claimed the top of the desk. It's made of porcelain and looks like it would shatter if dropped. And dropping it looks like it would lead to something terrible, so let's not.
house.sofa1: There's a sofa. It's made of leather and has fancy wooden armrests. The legs are wood too, with patterns carved into them. It's all smooth and shiny, a really luxurious-looking seat. Let's sit down.
house.sofa2: Ahh, this feels so nice. How much does this thing cost, anyway? Everything around it is covered in dust, but this is spotless. Whenever you need a rest, come sit here.
house.companions_talk: Friend 2: Phew.
Friend 3: That was tiring.
{player}: Yeah.
Friend 1: Anyway, let's talk.
Friend 2: Right.
Friend 3: So, {player}. You were gone a really long time. Is there really that much you can't figure out?
{player}: Yeah. I can't find any detailed information about what's going on.
And just like that Yamijin earlier, everyone is weirdly desperate for food.
Friend 2: So basically, there's a huge food shortage and everyone's going wild.
{player}: Yeah.
Friend 3: Come to think of it, rice has gotten weirdly expensive lately...
Friend 2: Right? Everything's gone up about 200 yen, I think.
{player}: That's pricey!
Friend 3: It's weird, right? Rice suddenly getting so expensive.
Friend 1: Maybe they raised the price because of the food shortage?
{player}: That's the part I don't get.
Friend 3: Yeah. The real question is why food is suddenly disappearing.
Friend 1: I doubt it, but maybe someone's short on food and hoarding it all?
Friend 2: Ha ha, no way. That's just silly.
Friend 3: Yeah, seriously.
{player}: No, I think it might actually be true.
Back then, the police officer said lots of people were buying up food at the supermarket.
Friend 3: But isn't that because something is causing the food shortage, so everyone's stocking up?
{player}: Right. That's another thing I don't get.
Friend 2: I just don't get it.
Friend 1: So maybe that's not it after all.
{player}: I don't know.
Friend 1: It's strange.
Friend 3: Way too strange.
Anyway. {player}, you don't have to worry about us.
So make sure you find out what's causing all this, and stop it.
Friend 1: I'm asking you too. At this rate, people are going to go wild.
Friend 2: Right. So you have to stop it.
{player}: Got it. I'll stop it for sure, and then I'll come back.
Friend 3: We're counting on you. Be careful out there.
Friend 1: We'll always be here at home.
Friend 2: We set up the chalk machine so you can get to Arkhaia.
house.board_cleaner: For some reason, there's one of those machines that suck the chalk dust off blackboard erasers in here. It's buried in, well, not dust exactly, more like chalk gunk. Gross. I don't want to touch it. Yuck. Nasty. Or is that going too far? And the power cord is plugged into... nothing... Creepy!
house.arkhaia_warp.confirm: Looks like this can send you to Arkhaia City. Warp there?
house.mansion_warp1: Th-this must be a Warp Panel...!
Maybe it's taking me to the Evil Mansion...
house.mansion_warp2: Oh crap, I'm starting to remember stuff about that kid. Let's stop this flashback right here.
Could this be the Evil Mansion?
house.mansion_warp3: Yeaaah! Yamijin, you stupid jerk-face! I'm gonna smash you straight into hell! Bwahahahahaha!
{player} just broke, so we'll skip ahead about 1 hour, 17 minutes and 36 seconds.
house.staff_desk: There's a desk here too. The kind you'd find in a school staff room. But there doesn't seem to be anything in the drawers, and it's covered in dust, probably from sitting here so long. Why is it even here? Decoration or something?
house.jukebox.confirm: Huh? There's a big box. Open it?
house.jukebox.cancelled: You decided not to open it.
house.jukebox.intro: Whoa! It's a jukebox! You can listen to the music from the game. Use the up and down arrows. Press Escape to close it.
Also, the jukebox loads stuff all the time, so it won't run very smoothly. Sorry about that!
house.painting: There's a painting on the wall. Looks like it shows the sky and clouds. Blue sky. White clouds. It's so pretty you could look at it forever. But you probably shouldn't be lazing around here. Well, whatever.
house.fountain: There's a fountain hole. Next to it is a switch, which apparently turns the water on and off.
house.humidifier.state0: There's a humidifier. It was plugged in, so you tried turning it on.
house.humidifier.state1: You're at the humidifier. But you need to fill this tank with water first.
house.humidifier.state3: You're at the humidifier. It's kind of nice and cool in front of a humidifier.
house.humidifier.state2: You're at the humidifier. You brought water, so you decided to turn it on.
house.humidifier.no_water: But it looks like there was no water in it. For some reason this room has no tap, so you just turned it off.
house.humidifier.pool_idea: Wait, there's water at the pool! Now you really want to fill it, so maybe you should take the humidifier tank to the pool.
house.humidifier.broken: Uh-oh. For some reason, the humidifier broke. Wait, aaaah! Now you remember, the pool water reeked of chlorine! Dang it!
house.chair.cat: There's a chair. But His Royal Catness already got here first, and is staring at you like, what do you want? It would be mean to sit on it, so you decide to just look.
house.chair.sit1: There's a chair. There was a cat here earlier, but it seems to have wandered off, so you can sit. Let's take a little break.
house.chair.sit2: Sitting here is kind of boring, so maybe you'll go explore the other rooms.
house.chair.cat_joke: Wait, come to think of it, you chased the cat off by swinging the hammer down at it. But you don't feel bad at all. It's the cat's fault for sleeping in a spot like that. "What a horrible person," says the author.
house.mode.intro: Huh? A strange stone is glowing on top of the old desk.
A daily life where everything is easy. Do you not find it boring?
house.mode.question2: O bored one. Do you wish to see the opposite of boredom?
house.old_desk: This seems to be a small desk. It's very old, and its wooden legs are rotting in places. There doesn't seem to be anything on top.
house.chest.found: You found a treasure chest. Inside was an old key, rusty in places.
house.chest.opened: You found a treasure chest, but you already opened this one. You've still got what was inside. But what could this key be for?
